name: Green Mountain Furniture
old_description: We trust that upon completing your virtual tour, you will accept our invitation to come and see for yourself why we have been singing since 1975, “Green Mountain Furniture, more than meets the eye."
about:
Green Mountain Furniture has operated in Ossipee, New Hampshire, since 1975. Named for the mountain range that borders the property, the business began as a destination for home furnishings in the Lakes Region and has grown into a 40,000-square-foot showroom spanning multiple floors.

The company functions as a full-line furniture retailer rather than a manufacturer. Its showroom stocks living-room, bedroom, dining, home-office, and cabin-style collections from brands such as Craftmaster, Flexsteel, and Best Home, along with mattresses (innerspring, memory foam, and latex), adjustable bases, area rugs, lighting, and decorative accessories. A delivery team also provides removal of existing pieces at the time of drop-off.

The primary customer base is residential shoppers furnishing primary and vacation homes, though the product mix includes medical-grade vinyl lift recliners that serve accessibility and healthcare needs. Shoppers can browse dozens of recliners, sofas, and beds without pressure from commission-based staff.

The founder's original pitch — “more than meets the eye” — still frames the value proposition: a large, low-pressure showroom where customers can physically test products, backed by a 100-night sleep trial on mattresses and a five-year Guardsman stain warranty on upholstery.
